# SeekerOG v0.2.0 Alpha

Big redesign of the music player, library and filters. Updates v0.1.0-alpha in place (same signing key, versionCode 2).

## Install

| File | Devices |
|---|---|
| `SeekerOG-v0.2.0-alpha-arm64-v8a.apk` | Most phones (64-bit ARM) |
| `SeekerOG-v0.2.0-alpha-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit ARM devices |

Android 6.0 (API 23) or newer. Package `com.eibyx.seekerog`. Check downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `VERIFY.txt` has the CI signature checks.

## New player (inspired by Namida's UX, re-implemented)
- Now Playing: blurred artwork backdrop with colours taken from the cover, tinted glowing play button, artwork that shrinks when paused, swipe to skip / tap to pause, quality pills (Hi-Res / Lossless, format, kHz, bit depth, kbps), thick rounded seek bar, transport row position · prev · play · next · duration, secondary actions with active dots, "Up next" card.
- Queue: thumbnails, current track highlighted, drag to reorder, swipe to remove.
- Audio info: badges and a grid with codec, bitrate, sample rate, bit depth, channels, duration, size, container and output route; unknown values are labelled as such.
- Mini player on the main screen and in the library.

## Library
Chip tabs, detail headers with Play / Shuffle, album grid, artist avatars, artwork thumbnails, format badges, play next / add to queue, current track highlighted.

## Filters
- Advanced filters as a glass sheet: section cards with counters, chips for formats, sample rate and bit depth, bitrate presets, rounded fields with units, saved profiles row, live summary, sticky Save / Clear / **Apply · N** (number of matching results).
- Quick filter sheet: visible / total counter, rounded field with an advanced-filters shortcut, chips for profiles, duplicates and syntax help, "Sticky" as a pin chip.
- Filters still produce the same text syntax; nothing changes on the Soulseek server side.

## Unchanged
Soulseek login, search, transfers, rooms, messages, background playback, MediaSession / notification / Bluetooth controls, favourites, playlists, CSV export, light / dark / AMOLED themes.

## Notes
Namida is under a proprietary EULA: no Namida code or assets are included; its UX concepts were re-implemented from scratch.

## Known limitations
- Tested on an Android 10 emulator, not yet on a physical device or with live Soulseek results.
- Queue drag / swipe gestures only checked visually.
- Real background blur only on Android 12+.
- New strings in English and Spanish only.
